aggregation.primary_value: grand mean produced by equal prompt then equal route then equal token weighting
aggregation.route_level: equal mean across the 50 routes within each prompt
aggregation.token_level: mean metrics across active tokens for each prompt-route

delta_semantics.source_target_normalization: L2-normalize each frozen source and target activation vector using the prospective replication semantics.
delta_semantics.zero_delta_rule: If float64 norm(delta) <= 1e-12, fail the experiment rather than silently exclude the observation.

evaluation_scope.routes: All 50 frozen recurrence-selected layer pairs from reference_topology.pairs.
evaluation_scope.tokens: All active tokens after T00 exclusion.

execution_state: No Qwen activation corpus has been opened or scored under this protocol.

mathematical_sanity.nested_projection_expectation: Mean relative L2 should not worsen as neutral depth increases from 0 through 4; violations must be reported.

hidden_delta_cosine.calculation: float64 dot(delta,reconstruction) divided by float64 norms; if reconstruction norm <= 1e-12, record cosine as 0.0.

max_abs_error.calculation: maximum absolute float64 difference between delta and reconstruction

next_if_fail: Use the frozen neutral outcome as the control baseline and preregister route-conditioned partition learning without changing this result.
next_if_pass: Preregister a route-conditioned shadow prediction experiment while retaining Qwen as untouched oracle.

primary_gate.meaning: PASS means the neutral hierarchy is strong enough to justify deeper inference experiments. FAIL means the neutral contiguous geometry is an inadequate predictive representation baseline and motivates route-conditioned MAF geometry. Neither outcome proves LLM replacement.

prohibited_claims: The neutral hierarchy predicts future tokens.
A screening PASS proves end-to-end compute reduction.
A screening FAIL disproves multidimensional MAF.
Depth-5 exact reconstruction is evidence of predictive inference.
question: How much of the frozen Qwen2.5-3B layer-transition delta is preserved by the deterministic neutral MAF-3D hierarchy at depths 0 through 4?
